title: Mitigate probe-amplification during autoscaler-driven kernel recompute
creator: Anika Patel
description: Summary: A 2026-03-09 capacity event exposed a probe-amplification regression where autoscaler-driven kernel recompilation and aggressive runtime probing combined to evict KV/ prefix caches and cause a sustained p95/p99 latency increase for large-context generations. This ticket captures the post-incident follow-ups, design decisions, and slated action items to prevent recurrence and reduce blast radius.
comments: 2026-03-09 09:18 - Anika Patel: Initial detection — abrupt p95 increase (1.8x) correlating with a scheduled autoscaler reconcile. Alert: latency-surge-runtime.orker. Investigating kernel compile logs.
2026-03-09 10:04 - Marcus Li: Found rapid kernel-probe bursts from new probe window logic in scheduler (probe-window shrink + probe-all fallback). KV cache miss rate jumped 23%.

2026-03-09 12:30 - SRE oncall (Riley Kim): Scaled up capacity to absorb traffic; enabled emergency-guard that pins stable kernel variants for 2h to reduce churn. Immediate mitigation reduced p95 by ~40%.

2026-03-10 08:15 - Anika Patel: Postmortem triage call notes: root causes appear to be (1) probe-window heuristic regression introduced in scheduler refactor, (2) aggressive kernel-recompile-for-probing, (3) autoscaler reconcile timing aligning with low cache warmth windows. Decided to create formal mitigation plan and telemetry coverage.
2026-03-11 15:22 - Marcus Li: Drafted small RFC for a probe-throttle gate and warm-start preheat; PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1482
2026-03-12 11:09 - QA (Lydia Ortiz): Started adding a deterministic stress test to emulated autoscaler reconcile window — test harness added to e2e-tests (branch: probe-amplify-sim).
decisions: Introduce a probe-throttle policy in scheduler that limits parallel probing to N concurrent kernel probes per node (configurable, default N=2).
Add a KV-cache warm-start window: nodes that recently served stable traffic will be preferred for autoscaler scale-out events for 5 minutes to reduce cold-cache evictions.
Disable aggressive recompilation-for-probing by default; require an explicit canary flag. Recompilation may be enabled behind a runtime feature-flag with telemetry gating.
Add a fast rollback playbook and an automatic pin-to-stable-variant circuit breaker that triggers when p95 increases >50% in 5 minutes post-deploy.
Create a telemetry dashboard that surfaces per-node probe rate, kernel-compile counts, KV cache hit ratio, and autoscaler reconcile timestamps.
action_items: Marcus Li - Implement scheduler probe-throttle and feature-flag control (PR in review) — in progress, target merge 2026-03-15.
SRE (Riley Kim) - Add warm-start affinity to autoscaler allocation policy and a guard to prefer nodes with >60% KV warmth — design doc linked; implementation target 2026-03-22.
Runtime team (Anika Patel) - Add compile-rate limiter to kernel build pipeline and require canary opt-in for dynamic recompiles — design complete, estimate 3 points.
Observability (Priya Shah) - Create a dedicated probe-amplification dashboard and alert with runbook (alert threshold: probe_rate_per_node > 4/min and kv_miss_rate > 15%) — ETA 2026-03-17.
QA (Lydia Ortiz) - Merge autoscaler reconcile stress tests into e2e pipeline and add nightly regression job — ETA 2026-03-14.
Oncall rotation - Update incident runbook with 'pin-to-stable-variant' quick action and include contact for runtime/ops oncall — immediate.
Product (Jordan Meyers) - Communicate issue + mitigation summary to affected customers and provide follow-up commitment — draft ready, send by 2026-03-13.
Engineering leadership (Sara Nguyen) - Allocate 1 sprint of focused work across runtime + scheduler to close remaining actions in this ticket — decision made in triage meeting.
Security (optional) - Verify that feature-flags and compile artifacts do not bypass existing artifact signing checks — low risk but scheduled as advisory review by 2026-03-18.
